newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market inactive - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market inactive - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were quiet following this week's brisk trading, which depleted showlists, market sources said.

Fed cattle prices next week were seen steady to firm on ideas the showlist will be smaller and demand strong, they said. Although packers bought a lot of cattle this week, a large number were earmarked for slaughter before the weekend, the sources said.
Prices this week were $105.00 to $106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady with last week's top after recovering from a $1.00 drop a week ago Wednesday.
Sales this week were pegged at 107,200 head, well above the estimated showlist of 93,000 head, they said.
